optical_silk_spool._note: Week 2 decision: one spool cuts rover uplink lag about 60 % (0.45 s to 0.18 s occluded). bad_grip_damage_chance: a robot with its grip torque out of tolerance damages the spool [PLACEHOLDER]. damaged_reduction_share: the part of that cut a damaged spool gives [PLACEHOLDER].

crystal_ore._note: Shallow cyan quartz fissures on the Terracotta Plateau (canon Tier 1). Regrow timing is a placeholder.

wide_treads._note: Bram: 'Bring me six crystal ore and I'll bolt wider treads onto your tractor. Cuts steering drift in half on loose dirt.' Halves usage (per-meter) drift only.

wheel_service._note: Bram re-torques the rover's five wheel nuts, in star order, once it has driven due_m meters since the last time [PLACEHOLDER]. Free. Nothing gets worse when it is overdue. The XP is in skills.json (service_wheels, lab_wheels) [PLACEHOLDER].
